parsed.note_claim: The airdrop planes in the video are US C-17 Globemasters, not Chinese, since China does not operate the C-17 and has not conducted airdrops to Gaza.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: China doesn’t even operate the C-17 aircraft. The C-17 Globemaster III is a large military transport plane used mainly by the United States and several allied countries, but not by China.
parsed.reason: The page directly states that China does not operate the C-17, that the footage shows a US airdrop over Beit Lahiya from March 2024, and that there is no evidence of Chinese airdrops to Gaza.
